imports.title: Imports
imports.intro: Load rooms, rates, guests, companies, what companies owed at go-live, or bookings still to come from a spreadsheet. The file is checked first and nothing changes until you confirm.
imports.later: Import rooms, rates and companies first: opening balances and bookings use them.
imports.step2: 2. Upload the filled file (CSV or Excel .xlsx)

help.ROOMS: One row per room. A new room type code needs its name on its first row; rooms already in the system are updated. Separate features with a semicolon.
help.RATES: One row per rate plan, room type and date range (from and to included). Prices in naira; leave the price empty to change only restrictions. Dates as 2026-12-01 or 01/12/2026; restrictions as yes or no.
help.GUESTS: One row per guest. A guest whose email or phone is already here is left as it is. Phones like 08031234567 or +2348031234567; separate tags with a semicolon; marketing consent and VIP as yes or no.
help.COMPANIES: One row per company or travel agent (kind: company or travel agent). A name already here is refused. Credit limit in naira; commission as a percentage.
help.BALANCES: One row per open invoice from the old system, for a company already here. The reference is the old invoice number and is imported once. The issue date defaults to today; the due date to the account’s terms. Needs the city ledger permission.
help.RESERVATIONS: One row per room booked, arriving today or later. Rows with the same old confirmation number are one booking; its first row gives the booker, company and source. Every night is charged the nightly rate in naira, as agreed in the old system. Each booking gets a new confirmation number; the old one is kept and can be searched. A booking whose room type is full on a night is refused. Deposits already paid are not imported. Needs the permission to make bookings.

imports.fileType: Use a CSV or Excel (.xlsx) file.
